Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: In Step 6, the Planner made a critical factual error by stating that "Helsingfors" normalizes to "Helsingborg, Sweden." Helsingfors is the Swedish name for Helsinki, Finland. Helsingborg is a completely different city in Sweden. This confusion led to incorrect instructions for the WebSurfer to normalize the birthplace to a Swedish city, which contradicts the actual historical and geographical facts (Gustaf Molander was born in Helsinki, Finland, which was part of the Russian Empire at the time). This error stems from a severe hallucination or confusion of names by the Planner.
